typography.headings: JetBrains Mono (REQUIRED for all headers to enforce cyber aesthetic)

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-slate-900/60 and thin border-cyan-500/20 for UI cards.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] on primary buttons, active terminal states, and neon accents.
visual_enhancers.grid_background: Add a subtle repeating-linear-gradient grid overlay (opacity 5-10%) to simulate a SOC matrix monitor.
visual_enhancers.terminal_ui: Use strict monospace text, border-l-2 border-cyan-500/50, and blinking cursors for SIEM/Kali simulators.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Avoid muddy gray. Use dark navy (#0B0F1A) or black with 'Tracing Beam' glowing borders for high-conversion sections.

layouts.landing: Asymmetrical, high visual tension. Use large spacing (py-24). Never center everything.
layouts.dashboard: Dense, high-data bento-grid (gap-4). Every pixel matters. Use h-full to stretch cards.
layouts.terminal_sim: Full-width or split-pane view, border-collapse styles. Rigid and technical.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very small radius (rounded-sm). Glow on hover.
components.badges: Severity colors (Critical/High/Medium/Low). Text must pass 4.5:1 contrast.
components.cards: Cardless or glassmorphism. Never pure white. Do not overuse standard Shadcn Card unless customized for cyber theme.

images.description: Matrix digital code. Use with low opacity as a section background or terminal overlay.
SOC Analyst working in the dark. Perfect for learning paths or scenario labs preview.
Padlock with neon light trails. Good for cryptography or security feature highlights.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update index.css to enforce the dark theme navy base (#0B0F1A) and neon accents globally.
Install and integrate 'JetBrains Mono' for all Headings, 'Inter' for body.
Animate the SIEM alert feed and terminal typing with 'framer-motion'.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent dark bg.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, terminal inputs, alert rows).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure neon text on dark background meets 4.5:1 ratio (APCA). Use text shadows if necessary.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for terminal blinking and scanlines.
